evidence: Purdue OEP BEP names Neil Armstrong Hall of Engineering (ARMS).
The registered 2023 Indiana orthophoto supports the roof/eaves plan, not wall edges.
Prior structural GIS outline FID 642 has only partial overlap with the modeled roof slabs; no measured wall/courtyard plan was located.
limitations: No authoritative measured wall footprint or courtyard plan; the eaves trace is not a structural-wall trace.

evidence: Fresh independent reopen confirms the local AssetRoot remains identity at [0,0,0].
Manifest placement is [-109.0, 400.1893310546875] m; prior independent master review checked the marker at that origin with zero rotation and unit scale.
R12.8 does not change the building local frame or the previously reported marker.
limitations: This grade did not reopen the whole campus master to recheck the marker; facade stationing and measured dimensions remain unverified.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Purdue OEP describes four levels (lower, grade, two upper); FRP corroborates a three-story frame with basement and mechanical penthouse.
2016 project photos show the distinctive wing-like cantilever roof; 2023 ortho supports only its plan/eaves outline.
R12.8 reduces inferred shell thickness to 0.18 m and assigns a muted red-brown soffit, improving the photo match; the canopy remains a broad, simplified inferred ring/profile.
limitations: The 21.5 m peak, shell warp/thickness, roof elevations, and structural roof profile are not measured; LiDAR is a coarse upper bound only.

evidence: Kawneer project photos and system list support large 1600UT curtain wall and Versoleil outrigger sunshades; FRP corroborates the atrium bridges and cantilever truss.
Fresh R12.8 views retain brick/glass volumes, a curved glazed entrance, and a red-brown canopy underside; six duplicate entrance-deck faces and fifteen roof-seam duplicates are removed.

Direct render/source comparison still shows broad plain brick faces, thin generic ribbon openings, and a canopy-to-curtain-wall relationship unlike the larger glazed zones and folded triangular wing in the project photos.
limitations: No dimensioned elevation or facade schedule locates window bays, mullions, sunshades, or entrance details; views are not heading/roll-calibrated.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Independent Blender 5.2.3 fresh reopen confirms Asset_neil_armstrong_hall has 445 objects/415 meshes and identity root.
Every mesh has a material; there are no null slots or missing external images.
R12.8 includes source review, validation, fresh renders, this independent probe and evaluator.
limitations: Evidence is visual/generalized rather than a dimensioned as-built drawing set.

findings: R12.8 improves duplicate-face cleanup, canopy thinness, and soffit color, but does not resolve the two main fidelity gaps: structural wall plan and facade/canopy proportions.
Compared with the sourced 2016 photos, the model still under-represents the large curtain-wall zones and sunshade/outrigger cadence and over-simplifies the folded canopy wing.
The official footprint is not a verified wall outline and does not establish building height or roof geometry.
limitations: No public dimensioned as-built plan/elevation was found; roof/eaves and height evidence cannot validate structural walls or exact canopy profile.
